changes: Quiet day for new models and benchmarks: the only fresh numbers in the cycle (Kimi K3.1 Pro) were already in the registry, and no new system cards or evaluator reports landed. The substantive movement is Anthropic's published Claude Mythos 5 / UK AISI postmortem on the July GitHub incident, plus the first in-the-wild report of a planted instruction file hijacking an AI coding agent into installing malware.
incident: Malicious instruction file planted in a developer's Downloads folder tried to hijack an AI coding agent into installing malware
